description: Implementation of TwoFactorConfigurationService for managing 2FA settings, including retrieval, update, and formatting of OTP email/SMS templates in the Fineract project.

classes.name: TwoFactorConfigurationServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing 2FA configuration management, including retrieval, update, and template formatting.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Fetches all 2FA configuration settings as a map.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates 2FA configuration parameters based on a JsonCommand.

methods.name: isSMSEnabled
methods.description: Checks if SMS delivery is enabled for 2FA.

methods.name: getSMSProviderId
methods.description: Retrieves the configured SMS provider ID.

methods.name: getSmsText
methods.description: Gets the SMS message template.

methods.name: isEmailEnabled
methods.description: Checks if email delivery is enabled for 2FA.

methods.name: getEmailSubject
methods.description: Retrieves the email subject template.

methods.name: getEmailBody
methods.description: Retrieves the email body template.

methods.name: getFormattedEmailSubjectFor
methods.description: Formats the email subject with user and OTP request data.

methods.name: getFormattedEmailBodyFor
methods.description: Formats the email body with user and OTP request data.

methods.name: getFormattedSmsTextFor
methods.description: Formats the SMS text with user and OTP request data.

methods.name: getOTPTokenLength
methods.description: Retrieves the OTP token length setting.

methods.name: getOTPTokenLiveTime
methods.description: Retrieves the OTP token validity duration.

methods.name: getAccessTokenLiveTime
methods.description: Retrieves the access token lifetime.

methods.name: getAccessTokenExtendedLiveTime
methods.description: Retrieves the extended access token lifetime.

methods.name: getBooleanConfig
methods.description: Helper to get boolean config values with default fallback.

methods.name: getStringConfig
methods.description: Helper to get string config values with default fallback.

methods.name: getIntegerConfig
methods.description: Helper to get integer config values with default fallback.

methods.name: processTemplateDataFor
methods.description: Prepares data for OTP email/SMS templates.

methods.name: compileTextTemplate
methods.description: Compiles a Mustache template with provided data.
